objective: Falsification campaign: does intermediate spatial execution granularity (8x8, 4x4) occupy an interior work-variance Pareto point between conventional 16x16 tile sparsity and iid 1x1 pixel sparsity, at matched expected pixel supervision budget?

backend.substrate_note: Structural + gradient oracle. G8/G4 are NOT native CUDA scheduling units; work is measured via STRUCTURAL_WORK_ORACLE (Gaussian-tile intersection counts from frozen projected state). Gradient fidelity is measured exactly via gsplat's own rasterizer + autograd on tile-masked L2 loss with inverse-probability weighting.

fixed_states.selection: room: 5000/15000/30000; garden: 5000/15000/30000 (s22 baseline); bicycle: 5000/15000/30000 (s22 baseline). All genuine trained checkpoints, no synthetic duplication.
fixed_states.minimum_met: >=2 genuine states per scene (each scene has 3)

gradient_reference.loss: L2 (MSE) per pixel on rendered RGB vs GT, summed over pixels
gradient_reference.rationale: Per-pixel gradient contributions are additive under L2, so uniform tile-subset with IPW yields an UNBIASED estimator of the dense gradient. This isolates granularity->variance without confounding selection policy. Identical camera/loss/resolution/Gaussian state/eps2d/SH degree across granularities.

granularity_definitions.G1: 1x1 iid pixel (each pixel its own execution unit)

sampling_policy: uniform random only; no error-guided/importance/residual/adaptive sampling

inclusion_probability.model: Bernoulli per execution unit (tile for G in {16,8,4}, pixel for G=1)
inclusion_probability.pi: p (equal-size units -> expected selected pixel fraction = p exactly)
inclusion_probability.boundary: boundary tiles have fewer pixels but same inclusion prob -> per-pixel inclusion = pi for all pixels -> unbiased

mask_seeds: 0..31, frozen, identical seed list across all granularities

variance_decomposition.note: uniform IPW should be ~unbiased; large bias investigated before interpreting variance

topology_diagnostic.note: not a GO/DROP gate for ORACLE0

work_definition.W_blend: approximated by same selected fraction (blend interactions scale with selected pixels for uniform tile sampling)
work_definition.no_runtime_claim: no wall-time speedup claimed from structural counters

runtime_calibration.reason: G8/G4 not native CUDA units; dense/tile/pixel runtime calibration deferred to Codex implementation phase per spec section 23
runtime_calibration.existing_modes: dense + 16x16 tile + iid pixel executable via gsplat; calibration planned but not blocking

go_gate.Gate_A: NMSE_cand <= 0.70 * NMSE_G16 on geometry macro avg, across >=2 of 3 scenes AND >=2 stages per passing scene (>=30% reduction; >=50% preferred)
go_gate.Gate_B: matched gradient cosine improves materially over G16 (not just norm shrinkage)
go_gate.Gate_C: W_cand,dense <= 0.70 for blend or intersection work AND no catastrophic other-counter increase
go_gate.Gate_D: at least one high-load scene (garden or bicycle) passes
go_gate.strong_go: G8 or G4: >=50% lower geometry NMSE than G16 AND W <= 0.65 dense on garden+bicycle for >=1 common budget and >=2 stages each

drop_gates.NO_GO_NO_INTERIOR_PARETO: G16 poor, G8 poor, G4 poor, G1 good
drop_gates.NO_GO_WORK_COLLAPSE: G8/G4 improve gradients but W > 0.85 dense
drop_gates.NO_GO_NO_VARIANCE_ADVANTAGE: intermediate granularity does not materially improve gradient fidelity over G16
drop_gates.NO_GO_NOT_GENERAL: benefit only on one low-load scene
